description: Source code for parsing and validating WebP images, including functions to check if an image is lossy WebP and to parse WebP image headers and VP8 frames.

classes.name: Vp8FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header information of a VP8 frame.

methods.name: IsLossyWebPImage
methods.description: Checks if the provided data represents a lossy WebP image.

methods.name: ParseWebPImage
methods.description: Parses a WebP image header and VP8 frame, returning a VP8 frame header if successful.
